We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with at least 5 reactions, using templates in order: ['29646', '1914389', '1914390', '149040', '1914391'].

We have applied 29646 to target, got three possible precursors (list). Need to choose one that can be further processed with next template 1914389, then 1914390, then 149040, then 1914391.

We have been trying various molecules. Need to construct a route tree JSON.

We need to ensure each step uses the specified template ID in order.

We must produce final route JSON with type "mol" root target SMILES, children reaction nodes sequentially.

We need to find actual precursors for each step that are valid (apply_template returns non-empty). We have some successes:

Step1 (template 29646) on target gave three possible precursors (tuples). The result string: "(('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C',))"

So three possible precursors. Need to pick one that works with template 1914389.

We tried applying 1914389 to first precursor (with Si protecting group) got result: "(('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C', 'CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC'),)". So it gave two products: one is a molecule (maybe precursor) and another is something else? Actually apply_template returns list of precursor SMILES for retrosynthesis (i.e., applying template to target yields precursors). So for step2 we need precursors from applying template 1914389 to the product from step1. The result includes two SMILES: first is a molecule with Si group, second is CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC (maybe a side product). We need to choose the relevant precursor that continues the chain.

We then applied 1914390 to that first precursor (C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si]...), got result: "(('CCOC(=O)C[C@H]1C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@@H](C)[C@@H](/C=C(/C)C(=O)OC)O1',),)". So that yields a molecule with Si group.

Then we need to apply template 149040 to that molecule. We tried applying 149040 to that molecule and got empty result. So maybe need different path.

Alternatively, we could choose a different precursor from step1 that doesn't have Si group, maybe the third one: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C". Let's test applying 1914389 to that.
